reason: At base the object JIT fastpass still assigns a swallowed superRefine value for an absent optional key, so safeParse({}) succeeds with key a present as leaked instead of omitting it.
After the fix both issue concat and value assignment are gated on presence, so an omitted optional with a failing superRefine is dropped and a present failing value still reports failure.
Before the change the paragraph continuation lookahead treated only spaces as blank, so a tab-only separator is absorbed and the two text lines become one paragraph.
The paragraph rule now treats [ \t]+ as a blank line, so a tab-only separator splits the two text lines into distinct paragraphs.
JSON response parsing is on the success path; the PR only wraps error-stack decoration in the catch handler and does not change default JSON body handling.
The stack-decoration try/catch still runs only on failed requests, so a 200 application/json response continues to expose parsed object data.
Boolean flags like --verbose never go through the negative-number detector; that regex only decides whether a leading-dash token is a numeric argument.
Widening the exponent to [eE] does not change option-flag matching, so a defined boolean flag still parses as true.
Before the PR JsonTreeReader.nextInt/nextLong call Integer.parseInt on string tokens with no ASCII check, so full-width digits are silently coerced to 123 instead of raising a parse error.
After the PR string tokens are validated as ASCII before getAsInt/getAsLong, so full-width digits raise MalformedJsonException as the test expects.
The old search_path regex is alphanumeric-only, so config value test-db is split at the hyphen into schemas test and db.
The new delimiter blocklist keeps hyphenated names intact, so search_path test-db is applied as a single schema name.
The PR only returns ArrayPool buffers on exception in ByteBufferUtil.fromStream and does not change ImageView transformation eligibility.
Buffer-pool leak handling is orthogonal to whether a configured center-crop runs when no dont-transform option is set.
allowed_symbols already unioned with alphanumerics before the cache; the test only needs that configured extra character to be accepted.
The cache rebuilds the same CharacterSet union when allowedSymbols is set, so an identifier using a configured extra symbol still passes.
Including cstdint in CharData.h is a compile-time header fix and does not change data-URI percent-decoding or SVG image loading.
Adding Afrikaans week/weeks locale strings does not change timezone-aware hour shift arithmetic across a DST transition.
The same cstdint include remains unrelated to percent-encoded SVG data URI loading after the PR.
Cookie-header parsing is unused when decoding an empty application/x-www-form-urlencoded body of an all-optional type.
Flattening all Cookie headers does not alter form-urlencoded content decoding of an empty optional-only body.
The PR only renames misspelled identifiers in a test and a comment; Remove of a non-empty in-memory directory is unchanged.
Spelling-only edits leave the in-memory filesystem still rejecting Remove on a non-empty directory.
The change only corrects json_encode flag arguments in a JSON type unit test and does not touch schema Comparator index-rename logic.
After the test-only json_encode fix, comparing a removed index with two equally valid added indexes is still the same Comparator path.
Afrikaans locale week strings are unused by datetime.shift of 10 hours across a US/Central DST boundary.
The PR wraps CircuitBreaker predicate evaluation; semaphore RateLimiter changeLimitForPeriod refresh is a different component.
CircuitBreaker permit-release on throwing predicates does not change RateLimiter replenishment after lowering limitForPeriod.
The prefer-template PR does not touch no-var; autofixing var a=1 to let/const puts a in the TDZ, so foo() before the declaration throws instead of logging undefined.
After no-var autofix, count is block-scoped, so the function invoked via schedule before the declaration hits the temporal dead zone instead of printing undefined.
The logformatter change does not persist SitemapSpider start requests; on JOBDIR resume sitemap URLs are typically already seen so the spider finishes with zero new pages.
Fixing empty/tuple log args does not make SitemapSpider replay unseen sitemap URLs from JOBDIR, so a restarted run can still close immediately with 0 pages.
Widening --sanitize bidi detection does not change highlight-line wrapping; a single double-width character at width 1 is a rendering path already distinct from the sanitizer.
The sanitize PR does not alter theme background fill or character wrap, so a full-row theme at terminal-width 1 should still exit 0.
RFC5424 regex cleanup is in the syslog parser, not out_file; a single multi-key flush historically only writes the last chunk's symlink.
The parser change cannot fix file-output symlink updates for a follow-up record after a multi-key batch; that path is unchanged and still incomplete.
ConcurrentBag yield/park changes run after the pool exists and do not add a System.getProperties lock during unnamed pool construction.
Switching virtual threads from yield to parkNanos does not introduce a shared lock between pool-name generation and System property access.
ACL sortGetKeys only changes SORT key extraction; BGSAVE of a few-megabyte dataset on 32-bit is the ordinary fork+rdb path and is unaffected.
Skipping the STORE argument in sortGetKeys cannot cause or fix systemd-triggered background saves of a small 32-bit dataset.
CTRL-A uses a 64-bit integer; a 50-digit decimal overflows and cannot become n+1 with all digits preserved, and the CWD fix does not change do_addsub.
CTRL-X has the same 64-bit increment implementation, so decrementing a 50-digit number still cannot preserve every digit.
Untyped NULL makes || pick a scalar/string bind rather than list_concat, so [1] || NULL is not INTEGER[] NULL; the file-cache race fix does not change typing.
The cache RetireBlocks change does not unify || and list_concat typing, so pipe_type can still be scalar INTEGER while func_type is a list.
RefCounted is already being destroyed when NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE runs, so reading a member from GDScript is unsafe; ScrollBar input handling does not fix that lifetime.
The ScrollBar touch-event change does not alter RefCounted teardown, so a PREDELETE handler that reads data can still crash.
f_regression still computes correlation via division by zero-variance, yielding NaN/sqrt warnings; the tree categorical absolute_error check does not touch feature_selection.
r_regression of a near-constant column still hits the same numeric path; DecisionTreeRegressor's new ValueError is unrelated.
The swagger-ui readonly attribute fix is UI-only and does not change Vault Agent file-sink chmod of mode 0640.
Removing leftover readonly on enabled Swagger fields cannot affect the token file's octal mode after auto_auth.
Before the fix write_usage with empty args calls wrap_text on an empty string, which drops the prefix, so the first help line is blank instead of Usage: cli.
After the fix an empty-args usage writes the stripped prefix, so a no-option command's first help line is Usage: cli.
Returning a dict as JSON is Flask's default JSON provider path; the PR only changes SERVER_NAME/host parsing for IPv6.
urlsplit-based host parsing does not change jsonify of a plain dict (application/json, compact body).
Required-field validation is core model construction; looking up deprecated aliases by id does not change missing-field errors.
The unhashable-generic-alias lookup change is only in schema generation for unusual typing objects, not required-field reporting.
logging.WARN is an alias of logging.WARNING (both 30), so default echo-off still suppresses INFO SQL logs.
Renaming WARN to WARNING leaves the same numeric level, so echo off stays quiet and echo on still logs SQL.
Before the method_missing change, once attribute methods exist an extra SELECT alias falls through to super without a NameError per read, so 50k accesses stay well under 20x a real column.
After the PR every missing extra_value send does public_instance_method rescue NameError before super, which is far more than 20x a generated column reader over 50k calls.
At base getCalledListeners walks the full callStack of WrappedListeners, so two dispatches of one listener produce two entries.
The leak fix stores each original listener only once in calledListenerInfos, so two invocations still report a single called-listener entry.
Custom completion hooks select values from the active command path; replacing COMPREPLY=(compgen) with a read loop does not change which subcommand is current.
The shellcheck COMPREPLY+= rewrite still fills suggestions from the current command's completion words, so sibling subcommands keep distinct hooks.
With qs 6.13.0, 25 repeated ids= keys are merged into a 25-element array rather than an index-keyed object.
qs 6.14.0 applies the default arrayLimit of 20 more strictly, so 25 repeated keys become a plain object with numeric keys instead of a 25-long array.
At base get_environ_proxies takes only url, so get_environ_proxies('http://example.com') returns a dict without TypeError.
The PR makes no_proxy a required second argument with no default, so calling get_environ_proxies with only a URL raises TypeError.
Before the change parse_unit_value rejects tokens that start with '.', so .foons is not treated as a duration and [.foons] stays a string list.
Allowing a leading '.' into parse_unit_value makes .foons attempt duration/filesize parsing and fail instead of remaining the string .foons.
At base HEAD still attaches a curl write sink; Accept-Encoding then makes libcurl try to write a decoded body and the request errors.
After the PR HEAD skips CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION/FILE, so a gzip Accept-Encoding HEAD completes with a status and no fatal curl write error.
A match assertion :foo = %{bar: [1 | 2]} uses the match formatter, which does not go through the new map escape, and inspect already prints improper lists.
maybe_escape skips maps in match context, so converting inserted/deleted maps to AST should not crash this :foo = map failure.
At base css_props teardown plus mismatched hydration_node (next_sibling vs first_child) drops the inner dynamic component's scoped custom property after re-render.
The PR removes the extra teardown and aligns dynamic css_props hydration, so the nested --prop color stays red across the outer-component toggle.
The old transform gate uses includes('new URL') and includes('import.meta.url'), then a \s-capable regex, so a multi-line new URL(asset, import.meta.url) is still bundled.
The new hook filter /new\s+URL.+import.meta.url/ uses a dot that does not match newlines, so the plugin never transforms a multi-line new URL() and the asset is not emitted.
Before FZF_CURRENT_ITEM exists, preview children are spawned without putting NUL-containing item text in the environment, so echo ok still runs.
Exporting FZF_CURRENT_ITEM= with a NUL inside the current item makes execve/env setup fail, so the preview child does not start.
Deprecated SYSTEM_UI_FLAG path does not reliably re-show bars when leaving immersiveSticky for edgeToEdge, which is the bug this PR targets.
EdgeToEdge.enable/WindowCompat is applied when entering edgeToEdge, so system bars are restored after immersiveSticky.
No multiple-assignment case checker exists yet, so ClassLabel(num_classes=num_classes) is valid Python and reports no syntax error.
The visitor insert()s keyword.attr and then the capture pattern, so num_classes=num_classes is flagged as multiple assignments to num_classes.
Decoding two nested value-blocks into a length-1 slice indexes sli.Index(1) without growing, which panics with slice bounds out of range.
The decoder now Appends when i >= Len, so two blocks overwrite/grow the placeholder slice to two matching entries.
Without an explicit mock timezone the mocked now keeps America/Los_Angeles, so Carbon::now() does not match the UTC default-timezone formatting.
setTimezone now falls back to date_default_timezone_get(), so a mocked LA moment is presented as UTC when now() has no timezone argument.
The old PROTOCOL_RELATIVE_REGEX requires exactly two slashes then a non-slash, so ///test.com, slash-tab-slashes, and /\/test.com are not classified as protocol-relative.
The expanded regexp /^([/\\]\s*){2,}[^/\\]/ matches all three unusual leading-slash forms as protocol-relative.
MD5("abc") does not use combineOrdered/combineUnordered; Hashing.md5 is unchanged.
getBytesInternal is only a copy-elision in hash combiners and cannot change the well-known MD5 digest of abc.
Moving unchanged RF001 descriptors into DiagnosticDescriptors does not stop generating a GET client for a verb-annotated interface.
Diagnostic codes and generator logic stay the same after the move, so the generated method still issues GET to the annotated route.
A plain HTTP/1.1 GET of a fixed Content-Length body does not depend on the redundant continue at the end of an unknown-frame branch.
Removing a last-statement continue leaves the same loop control flow, so the 200 body still matches the server content.
After convert!(Calendar.ISO) the code calls to_iso8601() with no format, so a Holocene date requested as :basic still returns 2001-01-01.
to_iso8601(format) is forwarded after the ISO conversion, so a non-Gregorian date with :basic yields 20010101.
On PHP 8.2+ setEndDate updates endDate but not the native DatePeriod end property, so ->end still shows 2024-09-30.
syncNativePeriod reconstructs the parent DatePeriod after setEndDate, so both end and getEndDate() show 2025-06-15.
With a pass-through normalizer the client builds a request line containing the embedded newline and does not raise before send.
headline now rejects request_uri matching /\s/, so a path with a literal newline raises RequestError instead of being sent.
Only the Albanian sq.yml million plural changes; English default still produces one million and two million.
Adding pluralName milionë for locale sq does not alter the English scale words for 1000000 and 2000000.
Singleton identity is the module/container scope path; the PR only changes how non-String Properties entries are loaded.
Ignoring non-string property keys cannot make two resolves of a declared singleton return different instances.
Replace-at-index already appends/swaps/removes and preconditions on duplicate keys; the test's expected order and error already hold.
Sharing OrderedSet's replace primitive is described as behavior-preserving and still rejects a new key that already exists.
The existing if size < 0 { size = 0 } already returns 0 for a negative size string such as -5MB.
max(cast.ToInt(sizeStr), 0) is equivalent to the previous clamp, so -5MB still yields 0 bytes.
findCaseInsensitivePathRec uses children[0] when wildChild is set, which is a static sibling, so /PREFIX/XXX or /prefix/a/b/c panics with invalid node type.
Static children are tried first and the wildcard is taken from the last child, so the mis-cased static route resolves and the unmatched path is a normal miss.
Int64Value calls toBigInt which returns the nil Int when Exp is 0, then IsInt64 dereferences it and panics for Numeric{Valid: true}.
toBigInt now returns big.NewInt(0) when Int is nil, so Int64Value and Float64Value both report zero without a panic.
Quit-from-another-goroutine is the program message loop; restoring tab stops only changes renderer setup and cannot keep Run blocked.
Conditional SetTabStops and SetTabEvery8Columns run during flush/reset and do not change the external Quit path.
At base RunUntilCancelledFuture still polls the inner future first, so an already-cancelled token starts the panicking operation.
run_until_cancelled returns None immediately when is_cancelled() is true, so the inner future is never polled.
Case-insensitive matching is in the search engine; skipping ignore-file loads at max depth does not change which lines match a -i pattern.
add_child_with_entries(&[]) only avoids parsing unreachable ignore files and leaves case-insensitive content matching unchanged.
skip_deserializing already sets Default::Default when the container has no custom default, so an omitted skipped field is zeroed.
Flattening the Default::None check to is_none() is equivalent, so skipped fields still get the type default.
